zh.reorderHint: 拖动排序，可跨组移动；Alt + ↑/↓ 调整顺序，Alt + ←/→ 切换到顶部/底部组。
zh.orderSaveFailed: 侧栏顺序暂时无法保存；本次调整在当前页面有效。
zh.visibilitySaveFailed: 侧栏显示设置暂时无法保存；本次选择在当前页面有效。
zh.settingsHint: 设置（右键打开账号菜单）
zh.restartHold: 长按1秒强制重启 DSH；松开进度回退，再按接续。关闭后在后台准备重开，请确认插件安装和任务均已完成。
zh.unavailable: 当前功能尚未准备好，请稍后重试。
zh.restartUnavailable: 外部重启工具尚未就绪，或无法确认当前 DSH 实例。请通过最新版一键安装包完成保护启动配置。无需宿主补丁。
zh.restartFailed: 未能确认重启结果，请先查看 DSH 是否正在退出或重新打开；不要连续重试。
zh.automationsUnavailable: 自动化任务尚未启用或未准备好，请在官方插件中检查。
zh.paneSaveFailed: 无法保存侧栏收起状态；本次选择在当前页面有效。
zh.resizeWorkspace: 拖动调整工作区宽度（方向键微调，Esc 取消）
zh.widthSaveFailed: 工作区宽度暂时无法保存；本次调整在当前页面有效。
zh.skillsUnavailable: 请先安装并启用 Skills Manager，准备好技能设置页面后可显示。
zh.restartUnsupported: 一键强制重启目前仅支持 Windows；macOS 请使用 DSH 原生退出并重新打开。

en.reorderHint: Drag to reorder or move between groups. Alt + Up/Down reorders; Alt + Left/Right moves to the top/bottom group.
en.orderSaveFailed: Could not save sidebar order. This adjustment still applies to this page.
en.visibilitySaveFailed: Could not save sidebar visibility. Your selection still applies to this page.
en.restartHold: Hold for 1 second to force restart DSH. Release to drain; hold again to resume. Preparation continues in the background after closing. Finish installs and tasks first.
en.unavailable: This feature is not ready yet. Please try again shortly.
en.restartUnavailable: The external restart tool is not ready or the current DSH instance could not be verified. Complete protected-launch setup using the latest installer. No desktop patch is needed.
en.restartFailed: The restart result is uncertain. Check whether DSH is closing or reopening before retrying.
en.automationsUnavailable: Automations is disabled or not ready. Check the official plugins.
en.paneSaveFailed: Could not save the sidebar state. Your selection still applies to this page.
en.resizeWorkspace: Resize workspace (arrow keys to adjust, Esc to cancel)
en.widthSaveFailed: Could not save workspace width. This adjustment still applies to this page.
en.skillsUnavailable: Install and enable Skills Manager to make its settings page available.
en.restartUnsupported: Force restart currently supports Windows only. On macOS, quit DSH normally and reopen it.
